status.description: Overall completion state of the delegated task.

summary.description: Concise factual summary of what was accomplished or why it is blocked.

changed_files.description: Workspace-relative paths of files created, modified, or deleted. Empty array if read-only or no changes.

notes.description: Short key output or error summary.

verification.description: Verification commands executed and their observed results.

risks.description: Remaining risks, caveats, untested edge cases, or blockers.

next_steps.description: Suggested follow-up actions for the orchestrator, if any.
